title: Goblin Business
description: One of the principal camp's merchants has decided that formal recognition is worthless unless it produces business. Complete a successful deal through the Goblins' own trading system and return to the merchant who made the offer.
description_completed: A successful Goblin deal has been made and the camp merchant has seen enough to count the Overlord as a customer worth remembering.

dialogue.offer: Leader says you are important. Important is nice. Buying is better. Do proper Goblin business, then come back and I will know whether you are important and useful.
dialogue.in_progress: No deal yet? Goblins understand many things, but a customer who does not buy is a difficult mystery.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: Ah! A real deal. Much better. Talking makes promises. Trading makes proof.
dialogue.completed: You buy, Goblins sell, everybody understands each other. Very civilized.

prerequisites.name: Establish formal contact with the principal Goblin Camp

objectives.name: Complete a successful Goblin merchant transaction
